svg.title: Synkora Agent Mesh — Multi-Channel Multi-Agent Architecture
svg.desc: Animated diagram showing eight inbound channels flowing into a unified routing layer, a central agent core with tools and memory, and an outbound multi-agent network with sub-agents, A2A protocol, parallel execution, debate, and human handoff.
svg.text: One Brain. Eight Channels. Infinite Agents.
Every message — WhatsApp, Slack, Telegram, API, widget, Chrome, mobile — routes to the same agent core.
Sub-agents, A2A protocol, parallel execution, debate, and human handoff fan out from there.

g.text: A → B → C · pass state forward
